downloads.fixture: Six existing pinned silent WAV cache entries with QQ/Netease domain metadata; no logged-in account or external audio request.
downloads.method: Hold real /api/downloads/export HTTP responses in CDP until game mode destroys the main UI, then release responses; normally quit with another four queued tasks; restart the same isolated profile and click Continue queue in the actual UI.

overlays.method: Open actual mini-player, desktop lyrics and wallpaper windows; pause via mini-player preload; return to UI; reopen mini-player; forcefullyCrashRenderer on the real playback host, once normally and once after game mode releases the UI. Recover through registered Dock activation; try enabled and late update IPC.
